caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher rendered in grayscale pencil on a light, cream-colored background. The pitcher has a wide, slightly flared base, a gently faceted body with vertical ribbing, and a smoothly curved lip that extends outward for pouring. The handle is angular with straight edges and attaches at the top and near the midpoint of the body. Decorative elements include a horizontal floral garland near the upper rim, floral accent motifs on the body, and an ornate monogram encircled by a leafy wreath beneath the garland on one side. The base of the pitcher is decorated with a subtle, engraved border. The shading throughout the drawing indicates a metallic, reflective surface, giving the impression that the pitcher is made of silver or a similar material. The background is plain except for a light vignette around the edges, and the artist's signature appears in small writing at the lower right corner.
title: Silver Pitcher
